item.text:
Refactored the heap sorter again to make the range-sorting path easier to follow and the tests easier to extend.

What changed:
- Simplified the extraction loop in [HeapSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSort.java#L41-L47) so it uses heap-relative indexes directly.
- Kept the heap internals centered around one offset and one heap size in [HeapSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSort.java#L50-L80), which reduces the amount of index math leaking into the outer loop.
- Reworked [HeapSortTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSortTest.java#L5-L180) into a table-driven harness with explicit case lists for full sorts, range sorts, and invalid ranges.
- Replaced repetitive one-off test methods with small case holder classes in [HeapSortTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSortTest.java#L110-L180), which makes it easier to add coverage without copy-pasting logic.
